description: CR 305.7 an animated Prized Unicorn set to Mountain no longer forces a block
note: With neither card declining to block is refused (CR 509.1c) and the forced block stands. Ashaya, Soul of the Wild under alice makes her Prized Unicorn a Forest land; Blood Moon then sets it to Mountain, and CR 305.7 strips its block requirement. This reaches the Unicorn's ability only through the layer-4 animation, so it reads the projection rather than base characteristics. Ashaya carries a +1/+1 counter because Blood Moon strips its own characteristic-defining ability too, and as a 0/0 it would die (CR 704.5f) before combat; the Haskell original read legality off a board where state-based actions never ran.
